about: The Iai's vertical draw (katana.k_iai, KE task 18), Elden Ring's: from the stance (iai_stance frame 5, blended in over 3 frames) a deep coil and a rising draw from the left hip up across to the right, from Attack1H04_R's cut made to rise (its tip low through the coil and raised through the cut, as Backhand Rise's), landing on frame 11.5 (about 24 rules frames after the stance's release) as a pushed-off lunge carries the body up into it, then held out high on the right, the arm raised out and the blade up from it (the pack's rise back towards the guard, its upper arm lifted by hand), to frame 33. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
